data.name: Land of the Dead Trees
data.detailed_description:
In the realm of Dead Trees, cursed trees spread fear and decay as they overtake the world. As a Lumberjack, your task is to cut down these corrupted trees, survive the journey, and reach the safe zone known as Purgatory before the world is completely destroyed.

This game offers a journey built around high replayability. Each run features different enemies, procedurally generated areas, and shifting challenges. Failure does not reset everything; the experience you gain and permanent upgrades you unlock make you stronger with every new attempt.

What awaits you in the game?

  • Fast and satisfying melee-focused combat
    Reflexes, timing, and positioning are essential when facing cursed trees and their threats.

  • Roguelike progression system
    Every death is not an end, but a lesson. Permanent abilities and upgrades gradually strengthen your character.

  • Multiple weapons and ability combinations
    A variety of weapons and active/passive powers shape each run into a unique experience.

  • Procedurally generated areas
    Ever-changing layouts and encounters ensure consistently high replayability.

  • Dark and distinctive atmosphere
    The cursed world of Dead Trees is supported by stylized visuals and an oppressive atmosphere.

  • The goal of reaching Purgatory
    Every struggle brings you one step closer to the safe zone. But the path will not be easy.

You will attempt this journey countless times. Each failure will make you stronger.

And through sheer will, perseverance, and determination, victory will eventually be yours.

data.short_description: "Lands of the Dead Tree A Rogue-Like / Extraction RPG" Walk the thin line between life and death as you struggle to restore a shattered world. Lands of the Dead Trees draws you into a breathtaking realm beyond your wildest dreams - where danger lurks at every step, and survival demands courage.
